literal_assertions.assertions: Label test_grouping, one parent group with both protein and RNA references.
One observation-match group with three registered match references.

source_derived_checks: Parent-group set labels are nonunique and registration always appends.
Parent groups are unique by parent-reference set, preserving first scores.
Observation-match groups merge scored payload by member-reference set.
Current processing step is appended only when absent.
Empty/singleton allSameMolecule/allSameQuery return true; larger sets compare exact references.
Group registration validates all score/member/history references.
native_checked_differences: ParentGroupSet uses an owned vector normalized before registration; every incoming value is checked including discarded duplicate entries.
Typed owner/slot IDs replace allocation-dependent pointer order.
Copy and merge retain/translate observation-match groups omitted by upstream merge.
Nested ParentGroup records count toward GraphLimits.max_records; work/bytes/edges are bounded.
